name: Lodavo
one_line_pitch: Canada's free prize-linked savings app — every $25 saved earns a free ticket into weekly cash draws.

do: Write like you're texting a smart friend — short, punchy, clear
Use Canadian references (TFSA, RRSP, OSAP, tuition tax credits, chequing accounts)
dont: Never sound like a financial advisor or use legal-sounding disclaimers in the main copy
Never be condescending about money struggles — students are broke and that's real

cta_text: Download Lodavo free — link in bio
banned_phrases: at the end of the day
disclaimer_text: General info only — not financial advice.
